identification: Fenn Mako Millennium elite racing surf ski (side decal reads 'MILLENIUM' under the Fenn shark/Mako logo), white composite, roughly 6.4-6.5 m, understern rudder, bucket seat with adjustable footplate and pedal/rudder lines, two round bailer/drain ports at the seat, Men's Health sponsor decal. viewing_check: Check hull and deck for cracks, soft spots and repairs (press around the seat, footwell and the brown mark on the side), rudder and cables work with the pedals, bailers seal, no water inside (shake/listen). Weigh it if possible (carbon ~11-12 kg, glass ~15+ kg) and look for a layup sticker or serial near the stern.
